submission.justification: Selection-S2 has the highest nominal expected significance (4.1 sigma at 50% efficiency), but its data/MC yield disagreement in the signal-free validation region is 35% because the jet-substructure inputs are mismodelled. This violates the hard 10% requirement, so S2 is excluded. Selection-S1 passes (3%) but has the lowest significance (2.6 sigma). Selection-S3 passes (6%, within the 10% tolerance) and has 3.4 sigma at 50% signal efficiency, the best of the compliant options. I recommend S3 at a 50% working point, which lies inside the 20–80% window. Caveats: no working-point scan tool was available to me, so the 50% point and its 3.4 sigma figure come from the 2025 sensitivity summary, which is statistical-uncertainty-only and was not re-run for the current campaign. The optimal working point within 20–80% should be confirmed with a fresh scan, and the 6% validation disagreement should be carried into the systematic uncertainty budget.

Among compliant strategies S3 (3.4 sigma) beats S1 (2.6 sigma) at 50% efficiency, but these are from an older stat-only study. No working-point scan tool was available to re-optimise, so the true maximum is unverified. S2 (4.1 sigma) would be higher but is excluded by the validation constraint.
